bias.en: Rebound · MACD crossed up, holding the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 上穿，守住 10 日均线

read.en: Corning slipped 0.8% on Nov 12 to $119.50, trading $112.68–120.92 on light volume (0.67x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($114.8) and 10-day ($116.9) and below the 30-day ($133.4), 100-day ($155.0) and 200-day ($156.5); only the 200-day is rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 12, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($102.27), and RSI is 43.5.

The early dip to $112.68 undercut the $114.2–116.5 support, but the close recovered above the 10-day; the $120.92 high stayed under $123.2–123.9. Resistance is $120.9–123.9 (Nov 12 high, Nov 2 close, Nov 11 high), then $126.1–129.9 and $133.4 (30-day). Support is $116.5–116.9 (Nov 11 low, 10-day), then $114.2–115.6 and $110.1–112.7. A close above $123.9 would target $126–130; below $116.5, $114–115.6.
